record.measurement_method: molecular dynamics simulation under applied electric field
record.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity of Li1/3 Pb1/3 Bi1/3 Te at T = 1.0 (295 K) was calculated to be 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm since unit
record.notes: Model rock-salt random substitutional crystal from MD only (no experiment). Composition is x = 1/3 in Li_x Pb_1-2x Bi_x Te. Temperature 295 K is the reduced-unit T0 value stated in the paper; converted to C as 21.85 for convenience. Conductivity_kind not specified in the paper; it is the field-driven conductivity from Eq. 4. The Summary repeats the same value. Dopant list left empty because Li/Bi/Pb are the base substitutional components, not dopants.
